findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: The scrolling track clips segment hit areas, so on a coarse pointer each segment keeps a ~30-32px target instead of 44px.
findings.fix: Grow the track to --a63-control-min-target on coarse pointers (a --segment-touch-floor in --segment-height) and assert it in MobileOverflow.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: In terminal dark the neutral selected segment is a quiet plate on the field-coloured track and its label barely changes.
findings.fix: Give terminal dark a tinted selected plate and a brighter selected label. Provisional until YZ sees it.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: Segments still cannot take their own props (aria, data, test ids); only tabClassName reaches them.
findings.fix: Allow per-item extra props or a renderItem.

findings.subject: segmented-control
findings.summary: segmented-control.mdx still lists the old track and pill tokens rather than the --a63-segment-* tokens the recipe reads.
findings.fix: List the --a63-segment-* tokens with their fallbacks.

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating input is controlled-only and disabled is ignored when read-only.
findings.fix: Add defaultValue with internal state, and document or drop disabled for read-only.

findings.subject: progress
findings.summary: Progress parts accept a state-function className in their types but silently drop it.
findings.fix: Omit and re-type className as string, or resolve it with state.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider drops the render prop and SliderValue drops function classNames.
findings.fix: Keep render on SliderProps; type SliderValue className as string.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner has no props type, no decorative mode and injects a <style> per instance.
findings.fix: Export SpinnerProps with label and decorative; move keyframes to spinner.css.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner's live region is an SVG with only an aria-label, so it may never be announced.
findings.fix: aria-hidden SVG inside a role=status span with visually hidden text.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider has no forced-colors treatment or capture, and no APG pattern test.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors block and ForcedColors story; add an APG slider pattern.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider's unfilled rail nearly disappears in dark modes.
findings.fix: Give the rail a visible boundary in dark. Provisional.

findings.subject: rating
findings.summary: Rating looks identical in all four themes and its Themes story is unlabelled.
findings.fix: Label the rows; YZ to decide on theme expression.

findings.subject: spinner
findings.summary: Spinner has no theme capture and its styles cannot be themed.
findings.fix: Move styles to spinner.css and add a Themes story.

findings.subject: checkbox
findings.summary: Checkbox's contract state invalid is never rendered in a story or baseline.
findings.fix: Add invalid (and invalid + checked) to States.

findings.subject: slider
findings.summary: Slider's disabled state is never captured and the thumb has no hover state.
findings.fix: Add disabled to a captured story; design a fine-pointer thumb hover.
